BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain termes)
  (:requirements :strips :typing :negative-preconditions)

  (:types
    position numb
  )

  (:predicates
    (at ?p - position)
    (height ?p - position ?h - numb)
    (has-block)
    (SUCC ?higher - numb ?lower - numb)
    (NEIGHBOR ?from - position ?to - position)
    (IS-DEPOT ?p - position)
  )

  (:action move
    :parameters (?from ?to - position ?h - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?from)
      (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
      (height ?from ?h)
      (height ?to ?h)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?from))
      (at ?to)
    )
  )

  (:action move-up
    :parameters (?from ?to - position ?lower ?higher - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?from)
      (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
      (height ?from ?lower)
      (height ?to ?higher)
      (SUCC ?higher ?lower)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?from))
      (at ?to)
    )
  )

  (:action move-down
    :parameters (?from ?to - position ?higher ?lower - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?from)
      (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
      (height ?from ?higher)
      (height ?to ?lower)
      (SUCC ?higher ?lower)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?from))
      (at ?to)
    )
  )

  (:action place-block
    :parameters (?from ?to - position ?old ?new - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?from)
      (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
      (has-block)
      (height ?from ?old)
      (height ?to ?old)
      (SUCC ?new ?old)
      (not (IS-DEPOT ?to))
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (has-block))
      (not (height ?to ?old))
      (height ?to ?new)
    )
  )

  (:action remove-block
    :parameters (?from ?to - position ?new ?old - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?from)
      (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
      (not (has-block))
      (height ?from ?new)
      (height ?to ?old)
      (SUCC ?old ?new)
      (not (IS-DEPOT ?to))
    )
    :effect (and
      (has-block)
      (not (height ?to ?old))
      (height ?to ?new)
    )
  )

  (:action create-block
    :parameters (?p - position)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?p)
      (IS-DEPOT ?p)
      (not (has-block))
    )
    :effect (has-block)
  )

  (:action destroy-block
    :parameters (?p - position)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?p)
      (IS-DEPOT ?p)
      (has-block)
    )
    :effect (not (has-block))
  )
)
END DOMAIN
